title: Add AI teacher improvement advice after successful Python runs
summary: Python Studio now shows code-aware improvement suggestions after a successful run and lets the learner request a fuller AI teacher review.

changes.detail: Added success-only advice for formatting, input validation, naming and reusable functions, localized for French, English and Arabic.
Added an Ask AI teacher for a code review action that sends the verified output and explicitly separates suggestions from tested results.
Styled the success advice card and added an interaction assertion for the Python Studio flow.
